pickup: Hello! I can help you choose a size L ski suit in Kazan. What weather are you shopping for and what is your budget?
For cold days on the slopes. Up to RUB 35,000.
Here are three suits in your size. I’d pick Glacier Warm for cold weather: it has the thickest insulation.
What is the Glacier Warm outer fabric?
Polyester shell, 20,000 mm membrane and 160 g/m² insulation.
Is this size in stock in Kazan?
Centre has three and Gorki has two. Where would you like to collect it?
Please check: Glacier Warm, size L, RUB 32,900. Pickup at Gorki in Kazan. Is that right?
